name: Rotating Photo Frame With Acrylic Hanging Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a high-quality wooden frame with a smooth walnut finish.
    - Includes a 360° rotating inner frame mechanism.
    - Product consists of:
                      +) Main Acrylic Photo Panel: Acrylic 3mm.
                      +) Acrylic Hanging Charm: Acrylic 3mm.
    - Comes with 3 metal circular rings (Ø 0.8 cm) for charm attachment.
    - Durable metal hook allows charm to hang securely inside the frame.
    - Sturdy construction with stable base depth for tabletop display.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall frame size: 22.5 x 20 cm ~ 8.86 x 7.87 in
    - Frame depth: 4 cm ~ 1.57 in.
    - Main photo panel: 8.89 x 15.75 cm ~ 3.5 x 6.2 in.
    - Acrylic charm size: 8.89 x 8.89 cm ~ 3.5 x 3.5 in.
    - Total length of 3 connected metal rings: 2 cm ~ 0.79 in, each metal ring diameter: 0.8 cm ~ 0.31 in.
    📌 Note: 
    - The frame and main panel dimensions are fixed and cannot be changed. 
    - The size of the acrylic charm may vary slightly depending on the design, as it is not fixed. 
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details and long-lasting color.
    - Features double-sided printing on the main acrylic photo panel and acrylic hanging charm.
    - High-definition printing enhances clarity and depth effect.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Features a 360° rotating inner photo frame for dual-sided viewing.
    - Acrylic charm hangs freely inside the frame for a dynamic decorative look.
    - Designed for tabletop display on desks, shelves, or cabinets.
    - Combines photo display with decorative hanging element.
    - Adds movement and layered dimension to traditional photo frames.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift that combines photos and heartfelt design.
    - Ideal for Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, anniversaries, birthdays, and holidays.
    - Perfect for couples, parents, family members, and pet lovers.
    - A unique keepsake that captures memories in a creative rotating display.
    - A decorative piece that blends sentiment, motion, and personalization 🎁.

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xRotating Photo Frame With Acrylic Hanging Charm

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
